aries.title: Aries
aries.summary: The first sign of the zodiac, Aries is a cardinal fire sign ruled by Mars, embodying raw energy, bold independence, and the pioneering spirit of a trailblazer.
aries.fullText: As the spark that ignites the astrological wheel, Aries represents the fundamental urge to exist and assert oneself. Governed by Mars, the warrior planet, this cardinal fire sign possesses an unstoppable, impulsive drive and a fierce need for personal freedom. Aries navigates the world with raw courage, unapologetic honesty, and an energetic, take-charge attitude. They are natural pioneers who thrive on breaking new ground and initiating action. However, their blazing impatience and intense focus on self-discovery can sometimes manifest as recklessness, combativeness, or a blinding disregard for consequences. At their highest expression, Aries channels their immense vitality and willpower into heroic leadership and passionate, creative beginnings.

taurus.title: Taurus
taurus.summary: A fixed earth sign ruled by Venus, Taurus seeks profound security and pleasure through steadfast loyalty, practical endurance, and the accumulation of material beauty.
taurus.fullText: Grounded in the physical world, Taurus is the master builder and maintainer of the zodiac. Ruled by Venus, this fixed earth sign processes life through the physical senses, finding deep spiritual and emotional comfort in tangible resources, luxury, and the serene beauty of nature. Taureans possess immense stamina, methodical determination, and an unwavering loyalty that makes them rocks of reliability. They seek to establish enduring worth and value in everything they do. While their steadfast nature ensures lasting stability, an over-attachment to comfort can sometimes harden into stubbornness, possessive materialism, or a resistance to necessary change. True abundance for Taurus blooms when they balance their physical wealth with an innate, unshakeable sense of inner self-worth.

gemini.title: Gemini
gemini.summary: Governed by Mercury, Gemini is a mutable air sign characterized by a quicksilver intellect, boundless curiosity, and a profound need for communication and variety.
gemini.fullText: Operating primarily on the mental plane, Gemini seeks to understand the world by gathering, analyzing, and exchanging information. This mutable air sign is endlessly adaptable, moving through life with a sparkling wit and a charming, dual-natured versatility. Ruled by the messenger planet Mercury, Geminis are the ultimate conversationalists, easily bridging differing perspectives and thriving on constant intellectual stimulation. Because their mental appetite is so voracious, they can sometimes scatter their focus, leading to nervous restlessness, superficiality, or a reluctance to dive into deep emotional waters. Their true brilliance shines when they harness their lightning-fast minds to weave diverse ideas into a unifying, articulate, and highly perceptive worldview.

cancer.title: Cancer
cancer.summary: A cardinal water sign ruled by the Moon, Cancer navigates life through deep intuition, seeking to protect, nurture, and build an impenetrable emotional sanctuary.
cancer.fullText: Deeply tied to the rhythms of the Moon, Cancer is the maternal, protective heartbeat of the zodiac. This cardinal water sign processes existence through profound feeling, instinct, and a powerful connection to ancestry and home. Cancers possess a vivid imagination and an almost psychic empathy, instinctively sensing the vulnerabilities of others and fiercely protecting those they love. Because their emotional permeability is so extreme, they often retreat into a protective, crusty shell when threatened, and their intense sensitivity can sometimes lead to clinging behaviors or shifting moods. True strength emerges when Cancer learns to mother their own spirit first, allowing their immense, nurturing grace to offer profound, universal comfort.

leo.title: Leo
leo.summary: Radiating the warmth of the Sun, Leo is a fixed fire sign defined by dramatic creativity, noble pride, and a generous, passionate desire for recognition.
leo.fullText: Stepping boldly into the center stage of life, Leo operates with the magnificent, theatrical flair of royalty. Ruled by the Sun, this fixed fire sign possesses an unshakeable self-confidence, immense vitality, and a deeply loyal, joyous heart. Leos express their identities through passionate romance, artistic creation, and an inherent need to be recognized and celebrated for their unique brilliance. While their radiant charisma naturally attracts followers and inspires others, their ego's demand for applause can occasionally warp into vanity or domineering pride. When they channel their abundant warmth unconditionally and lead with true magnanimity, Leo becomes an unparalleled beacon of inspiring, life-giving light.

virgo.title: Virgo
virgo.summary: A mutable earth sign ruled by Mercury, Virgo seeks perfection and wholeness through meticulous analysis, practical service, and an unparalleled work ethic.
virgo.fullText: Grounded in the tangible details of daily life, Virgo acts as the ultimate craftsman and healer of the zodiac. Governed by a highly analytical iteration of Mercury, this mutable earth sign expresses itself by organizing chaos, solving complex practical problems, and offering relentless, devoted service to others. Virgos possess a deeply discriminating mind and a profound understanding of the connection between the physical body and the environment. However, their intense drive for absolute purity and perfection can sometimes spiral into debilitating anxiety, hypochondria, or harsh self-criticism. By accepting the inherent divine beauty within human flaws, Virgo's precise discipline transforms into an instrument of profound, practical compassion.

libra.title: Libra
libra.summary: Ruled by Venus, Libra is a cardinal air sign that seeks ultimate harmony, justice, and aesthetic beauty through the delicate art of partnership and diplomacy.
libra.fullText: Existing fundamentally in the mirror of the 'other', Libra is the cosmic architect of social equilibrium. This cardinal air sign approaches the world with refined grace, a brilliant objective intellect, and a deeply ingrained desire to bridge opposing viewpoints. Governed by Venus, Libras are natural mediators and artists who find their greatest comfort in peaceful, equitable, and beautifully structured environments. Because their aversion to conflict is so absolute, they can sometimes struggle with chronic indecisiveness or compromise their own authentic boundaries to keep the peace. True balance is achieved when Libra combines their unparalleled diplomatic charm with the courage to assert their independent truth.

scorpio.title: Scorpio
scorpio.summary: A fixed water sign ruled by Pluto and Mars, Scorpio navigates the profound depths of the psyche, driven by passion, hidden truths, and absolute transformation.
scorpio.fullText: Plunging into the dark, powerful mysteries of existence, Scorpio operates with terrifying intensity and magnetic emotional depth. This fixed water sign is entirely uninterested in superficiality; it seeks soul-deep merging and the uncovering of taboo, psychological truths. Ruled by Pluto and traditionally Mars, Scorpios possess a fiercely protective nature, an uncompromising willpower, and an uncanny ability to survive and regenerate from absolute crisis. Yet, their profound fear of betrayal can easily trigger brooding paranoia, jealousy, or an obsessive need to control their intimate environments. By courageously surrendering to vulnerability, their intense, penetrating power becomes a miraculous force for healing and ultimate spiritual rebirth.

sagittarius.title: Sagittarius
sagittarius.summary: Governed by Jupiter, Sagittarius is a mutable fire sign characterized by an adventurous, optimistic spirit and a boundless quest for ultimate philosophical truth.
sagittarius.fullText: Aiming its arrows toward the furthest horizons, Sagittarius is the restless visionary and explorer of the zodiac. This mutable fire sign operates on a grand scale, driven by an insatiable thirst for meaning, higher education, and the freedom to roam across physical and ideological borders. Ruled by expansive Jupiter, Sagittarians are brutally honest, enthusiastic teachers who inspire others with their sweeping, global perspectives. Because they absolutely abhor limitation, their boundless confidence can sometimes manifest as tactless bluntness, dogmatic arrogance, or a fear of committing to mundane, practical reality. Grounding their lofty ideals allows their brilliant, soaring faith to genuinely enlighten the world.

capricorn.title: Capricorn
capricorn.summary: A cardinal earth sign ruled by Saturn, Capricorn is the pragmatic architect of the zodiac, achieving worldly authority through grueling discipline and relentless ambition.
capricorn.fullText: Defining existence through tangible achievement and structural endurance, Capricorn operates with cautious realism and an unparalleled capacity for hard work. Ruled by the stern taskmaster Saturn, this cardinal earth sign seeks to climb the highest peaks of societal status, shouldering immense responsibility to build secure, long-lasting empires. Capricorns are natural executives who possess the emotional control to delay immediate gratification for future success. However, their intense focus on reputation and material security can sometimes make them appear emotionally cold, ruthlessly calculating, or prone to deep-seated pessimism. By integrating spiritual compassion with their formidable worldly drive, their enduring achievements bring true, lasting fulfillment.

aquarius.title: Aquarius
aquarius.summary: Governed by Uranus and Saturn, Aquarius is a fixed air sign that champions progressive ideals, intellectual freedom, and the radical reform of society.
aquarius.fullText: Operating on a frequency far ahead of its time, Aquarius is the visionary rebel of the astrological wheel. This fixed air sign processes the world through brilliant, objective logic, driven by a deeply ingrained humanitarian desire to shatter outdated paradigms and establish universal equality. Aquarians are fiercely independent, eccentric thinkers who thrive within large social networks and progressive coalitions. Because their focus is so intensely collective and theoretical, they can often appear emotionally aloof, stubbornly detached, or disconnected from the messy intimacy of individual relationships. Infusing their brilliant, futuristic blueprints with personal, tender warmth unlocks their true capacity to revolutionize the world.

pisces.title: Pisces
pisces.summary: A mutable water sign ruled by Neptune and Jupiter, Pisces embodies boundless, mystical compassion, dissolving earthly boundaries to merge with the universal soul.
pisces.fullText: As the final stage of the zodiacal journey, Pisces represents the dissolution of the individual ego into the vast ocean of collective consciousness. This mutable water sign is deeply intuitive, romantic, and artistically gifted, navigating reality through dreams, symbols, and profound empathy. Ruled by the illusive planet Neptune, Pisceans absorb the unspoken pain and beauty of their environment, making them natural healers and spiritual channels. However, this extreme emotional permeability makes them highly vulnerable to escapism, illusion, or adopting a crippling martyr complex when overwhelmed by the world's harshness. By forging strong psychological anchors, their immense, poetic grace becomes an exquisite instrument for universal redemption.
